_comment: Category-to-token assignment for explicit multi-interest training on the 64-d qbfeed_action_flow item pool. Semantic clarity prioritized over balance -- the item pool naturally skews toward entertainment (~48%), and forcing 1/3 balance requires cross-semantic moves that make the tokens hard to interpret. We accept the 48/32/20 skew instead.
_source: Derived from category_stats.py output on 3,080,187-item pool (10,125 unlabeled dropped -> 3,070,062 labeled).
_generated: 2026-07-20 manual assignment. Small-tail categories (<=200 items each) are backfilled to the semantically closest bucket (剧情长尾 -> token_1, 摄影/星座/壁纸 -> token_2, 历史朝代 -> token_3).

_totals._note_on_imbalance: token_3 at 19.85% is smaller than a uniform 33% partition. Training signal per token will scale with pool share, so token_3 will train slower than token_1/2, but it will still receive gradient every step from users whose pos items land in this bucket. This is preferable to muddling semantics: PMs / analysts can read 'this token is the user's affinity for X' for each of the three tokens.

_semantics.token_1: 娱乐观赏 -- 明星影视 + 短视频消遣 + 剧情文学 (娱乐/电视剧/电影/综艺/网红达人/音乐/美女/搞笑/动漫/剧情类长尾).
_semantics.token_2: 生活起居 -- 衣食住行 + 家庭 + 生活兴趣活动 (生活/美食/宠物/育儿/健康/时尚/情感/体育/游戏/旅游).
_semantics.token_3: 社会知识 -- 社会时事资讯 + 科普学习 (社会/时事/军事/汽车/财经/房产/三农/科技/科学/历史/文化/教育/纪录片/职场).
